parameters.name: GroupId
parameters.description: The ID of the domain name group. You can call the [DescribeDomainGroups](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/dns/api-alidns-2015-01-09-describedomaingroups?spm=a2c63.p38356.help-menu-search-29697.d\_0) operation to obtain the ID.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

*   zh: Chinese
*   en: English

Default value: en.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns delete-domain-group --lang en --group-id d367113100944e488352f99e3c7d0000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alidns DeleteDomainGroup --region cn-hangzhou --Lang en --GroupId d367113100944e488352f99e3c7d0000
